scope: Remove redundant per-lookup static asset hashing using one authenticated private immutable registry; preserve all current-source and authority checks.
riskAnalysis: Only immutable reviewed task data is cached after hash authentication. Caller mutation must not affect trusted definitions; dynamic file identities, grants and deadlines remain fresh. Hosted15s timeout cause remains only partially established.

threatModel.assets: Source/task identity, frozen receipt integrity, current dashboard read state, permissions and publication boundaries.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Server-authenticated descriptor and immutable source asset vs untrusted model patch; disposable data copy vs actual repository; Work publication vs internal agents.
threatModel.abuseCases: Forged descriptor, arbitrary regex/path/test profile, stale source substituted for current, source execution escalation, altered review, real account mutations hidden in QA.
threatModel.mitigations: Whole-asset hash/exact descriptor equality, one-edit closed grammar,512bytes, exact preimage/binding/evidence, source-only admission, current resolved-task denial, fixed VM source-hash rejection, no new paid policy, fully intercepted synthetic browser mutations.

defects.rootCause: Each negative historical objective lookup serialized and hashed the entire static compressed task asset.
defects.detectionGap: Focused correctness cases did not quantify repeated historical lookup overhead.
defects.regression: Measured10000lookups before9527ms/after1.6ms; mutation-isolation and startup-tamper denial; old frozen request contracts and fullfive-stage disposable fixture.
defects.historicalPrevention: Authenticate static asset at module load then keep a private deeply frozen clone; never cache source or authorization checks. Preserve original timeout evidence and qualify hosted successor.

rollback: Revert only this feature Preview batch on verification failure; preserve all source/history/diagnostic evidence and revoked grants. No main or Production mutation.

proactiveReview.architecture: Extend existing five-stage workflow and patch validator with immutable task data, not new orchestration.
proactiveReview.dependencies: No new packages, credential changes, provider requests or infrastructure.
proactiveReview.threats: Forged descriptor, arbitrary regex/path/test profile, stale source substituted for current, source execution escalation, altered review, real account mutations hidden in QA.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Resolved/current drift denies new tasks; history remains readable. Fixture success does not prove live reasoning or dynamic execution.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Descriptor/path/source/workspace/grammar/protected command substitutions, no test-profile inheritance, concurrent read refresh failure paths.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Root reviews QA-authored browser/test fixtures; independent Work QA/Auditor review root task/product implementation. Final hosted review required.
proactiveReview.recovery: Retain original source snapshots, all old receipts/rejections and v1-v5 evidence. Work-only source publication, no grant revival.
